_about: INVENTED DATA for a book example. Stands in for the CRM (Veeva-style) and content data products a pre-call agent would read. NPIs start with 9 because real NPIs start with 1 or 2, so none can match a real clinician. Brands Zentivra and Lumotrex are fictional. Phone numbers use the 555-01xx fiction range and emails use the .example domain.

hcps.segment: Moderate writer, open to new data

Opened the email, clicked the Prescribing Information link.

approved_content.title: Core efficacy message
approved_content.text: In the pivotal trial, Zentivra reduced the risk of heart failure hospitalization versus placebo. See full Prescribing Information.

approved_content.title: Dosing and titration
approved_content.text: Zentivra is taken once daily. Titrate per the Prescribing Information based on tolerability and renal function.

approved_content.title: Access and affordability
approved_content.text: Eligible commercially insured patients may pay as little as $10 per month with the Zentivra savings program. Restrictions apply.

approved_content.text: Lumotrex improved lung function at week 12 versus placebo in adults with moderate to severe asthma. See full Prescribing Information.
